summary: ### Name of the resource AWS::Glue::Job ### Description #### Scope of request CloudFormation’s AWS::Glue::Job resource type with the WorkerType property only allows the use of the following values: `Standard | G.1X | G.2X | G.025X | G.4X | G.8X | Z.2X` [[1]](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-glue-job.html#cfn-glue-job-workertype). AWS Glue recently introduced two larger general-purpose workers (G.12X, G.16X) and four memory-optimized workers (R.1X, R.2X, R.4X, R.8X) [[2]](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/07/aws-glue-supports-new-
title: AWS::Glue::Job - Support for new G.12X, G.16X and R memory-optimized worker types
